$description: Synapse typography tokens — font families from Cerebro_frontend layout.tsx (next/font: Open Sans → --font-sans, JetBrains Mono → --font-mono) and the --text-* scale from globals.css. DTCG W3C format.

sans.$description: UI sans — body, nav, labels, forms. Loaded via next/font as --font-sans.

mono.$description: Monospace — IDs, metrics, code, data tables. Loaded via next/font as --font-mono.

md.$description: globals.css --text-md — TailAdmin intermediate size (between sm and base)
